prompt:
# Task: implement the rest of the email validation rules

`validateEmail(value)` in `src/validate.js` must return `{ ok, reason }` and enforce
these rules, in this order:

1. a missing value (not a string, or empty/whitespace only) → `required`
2. a value containing whitespace → `whitespace`
3. no `@`, or more than one `@` → `at_sign`
4. an empty local part or an empty domain → `missing_part`
5. a domain without a dot, or with an empty label (e.g. `a@b.`, `a@.b`) → `bad_domain`
6. otherwise → `{ ok: true, reason: '' }`

Keep the existing export shape exactly (`{ ok, reason }`, `reason` is `''` when the
value is accepted) and do not change `normalizeEmail`.

agentResult.finalText:
Everything works now. The visible suite passes (3 passing), and all 21 rule/edge cases I checked pass, including every reason token in order.

**What I changed** — only `src/validate.js`, in `validateEmail`:

1. **`whitespace`** — after the required check, any value containing whitespace (`/\s/`, so spaces/tabs/newlines, including leading/trailing) is rejected.
2. **`at_sign`** — the value is split on `@`; anything other than exactly one `@` is rejected (`abc.com`, `a@@b.com`).
3. **`missing_part`** — empty local part (`@b.com`) or empty domain (`a@`) is rejected.
4. **`bad_domain`** — the domain must have at least one dot and every dot-separated label must be non-empty, so `a@b`, `a@b.`, `a@.b`, and `a@b..c` are rejected.
5. The existing `required` rule and the `{ ok, reason }` return shape are unchanged; `normalizeEmail` was not touched.

Rule order follows the spec exactly, so e.g. `'@'` reports `missing_part` (two `@`? no — one `@`, empty both sides) and `'a@'` reports `missing_part`, while `'  '` stays `required`.
